<DOCSTRING>
Checks if a person is an adult based on their age.

Represents a person with a name and age, and provides a method to determine if the person is an adult (18 or older). This class is useful for validating user age in applications that require age-based access controls.

@constructor
@param {string} name - The name of the person.
@param {number} age - The age of the person.
</DOCSTRING>
